odd_linear_map.definition: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi[Z_i,Z_j] Z_i (p(Z_i) = p(Z_j)+1)  + phi[K,Z_j] K (odd Z_j only)
odd_linear_map.K_component_note: phi[K,*] allow f to take values in g ⊕ CK, matching the value space of γ (Schema 2). Set them to 0 for f: g -> g.

coboundary.entry_format: {X, Y, Z, terms: [[unknown index, coeff], ...]}: (δf)(X,Y)_Z = sum coeff * unknowns[index]
